messages:
Nora (People Ops): Kicking off White-Glove Recognition pilot — concierge payout flow for high-impact awards (> $500). Need payroll & legal sign-off on process docs by Fri. Who can review?
Ethan (People Ops): I can take the process doc draft. Posting draft fields below for quick review.
Nora (People Ops): Fields: recipient_name, recipient_email, org, award_amount_usd, award_reason (200 chars), award_type (spot / milestone / peer-nominated), payout_method (payroll / vendor / prepaid_card), manager_approval_ts, legal_clearance (yes/no), tax_flag (yes/no), recipient_country, vendor_id (if vendor).
Tess (Payroll): Quick note: vendor payouts need vendor onboarding lead time (3 business days). Payroll payouts need pay cycle timing; cutoffs are Wed 11am PT for same-week inclusion. For >$600 we must flag for tax reporting.
Hannah (Legal): Also need recipient attestation for gifts in some regions. Add a checkbox: "I accept this award and confirm eligibility" or we need written consent.
Diego (Eng Manager): For manager_approval_ts, can approval be a Slack action or must be an email? Managers are busy.
Ethan (People Ops): We'll support both: Slack approve button -> populates manager_approval_ts; fallback is manager_email.
Nora (People Ops): Process proposal: 1) People Ops triages nominations 2) Legal reviews for >$2k or international recipients 3) Payroll picks payout path 4) Ops confirms delivery and records in ledger.
Tess (Payroll): Sounds OK. For international, specify currency and whether customs paperwork is needed. I'll add a country -> payout option map.
Hannah (Legal): Add a short clause to the recipient email: "This award may have tax implications in your jurisdiction."
Diego (Eng Manager): Can we have a private reason field for ops to store manager notes (not shared in public shoutouts)?
Ethan (People Ops): Yes, internal_note field will exist and be ops-only.
Nora (People Ops): Pilot logistics: 4 awards total across Eng, Sales, and Product teams over two weeks. Objectives: confirm timing SLAs, tax handling, and manager UX.
Diego (Eng Manager): I'll nominate one IC by Monday.
Tess (Payroll): For testing, use test recipient test.user+wg@redwood.ai and vendor_id TEST-VEND-001. I'll run a dry-run payment.
Ethan (People Ops): We'll create an Airtable form and a private managers-only approval channel. Nora and I will monitor for duplicates and missing legal_clearance.
Nora (People Ops): Announcement plan: internal managers-only doc + public #wins post for each delivered award (unless recipient opts out). announce-bot will post.
announce-bot: Scheduled post created: "White-Glove Recognition pilot starts Mon 3/2" in #general at 9:00 AM PT. :sparkles:
Hannah (Legal): One more: track country-specific opt-in requirements in a lookup table. I'll share the initial list by Thu.
Tess (Payroll): Confirmed I'll test prepaid card flow and payroll inclusion. Expect feedback by Fri.
Ethan (People Ops): Metrics to capture: time from manager_approval -> payout, tax escalations, manual interventions, opt-outs.
Diego (Eng Manager): Happy to help measure. Also please include manager-facing examples of acceptable award reasons.
Nora (People Ops): Will draft manager playbook and examples today and post here. Thanks everyone — aiming to go live with pilot volunteers on Mon. Ping me if you want to join.
